value.answer: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot, offering native vision support for image understanding and improvements in coding quality, instruction following, tool use, and performance. This model is available to Copilot Free and Student users through auto model selection, while Copilot Pro, Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users can manually select it in addition to auto selection.
